plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Paralegal Studies Certificate (Full Time, Summer Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 15, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7379/PublishedPdf), Start Term: Summer. Total Units 30 = 3+12+15 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Admission: students must possess an A.A. degree or higher from a regionally accredited institution to be eligible for this certificate. Scheduling notes: PLGL 300 is offered in the fall, spring, and summer; PLGL 310, 312, 314, and 350 are offered in the fall and spring; PLGL 320 is offered in the fall regularly, and in the spring and summer occasionally; PLGL 321 is offered in the spring regularly, and in the fall and summer occasionally; PLGL 330, 332, 336, and 342 are offered in the fall; PLGL 334, 360, 362, and 365 are offered in the spring. A PLGL 498 internship (0.5-4.0 units) is highly recommended.
